body_markdown:
Glass.AI has been selected to join the[Barclays Eagle Labs Scaleup Programme](https://labs.uk.barclays/what-we-offer/our-programmes/scaleup/) as one of 25 UK technology companies chosen for this year’s cohort.


Selected from a competitive field of applicants, Glass.AI will take part in the programme alongside other ambitious technology scaleups from across the UK.


Delivered by[Barclays Eagle Labs](https://labs.uk.barclays/) in partnership with[Plexal](https://www.plexal.com/) , the programme is designed to support high-growth technology companies as they scale, bringing together founders and business leaders for expert-led sessions, mentoring and peer learning.
